sourceTiers.text: Equipping both <Trialedge Spear|781|#C|20204> and <Peakwane Spear|781|#C|20205> allows you to activate both <Rainhush Verdict|781|#C|20204|20204201> and <Windcalm Plunder|781|#C|20205|20205201>. Unleashing these Varied Combos and their triggered effects grants enhancements based on the Martial Art in use: <Trialedge Spear|781|#C|20204> deals an additional #Y5%#E Affinity damage, while <Peakwane Spear|781|#C|20205> grants #Y5%#E HP Drain.

Casting <Rainhush Verdict|781|#C|20204|20204201> and <Windcalm Plunder|781|#C|20205|20205201> grants #YClear Law#E and #YNoble Path#E respectively: #YClear Law#E increases HP damage dealt by the next <Windcalm Plunder|781|#C|20205|20205201> by #Y10%#E, while #YNoble Path#E increases HP damage dealt by the next <Rainhush Verdict|781|#C|20204|20204201> by #Y10%#E. If the target is a non-player unit, these damage boost effects are enhanced to #Y20%#E.

While #YLethal#E is active, Clear Law and Noble Path are enhanced into #YClear Law: Pierce#E and #YNoble Path: Pierce#E. #YClear Law: Pierce#E increases HP damage dealt by the next <Windcalm Plunder|781|#C|20205|20205201> by 15%, while #YNoble Path: Pierce#E increases HP damage dealt by the next <Rainhush Verdict|781|#C|20204|20204201> by 15%. If the target is a non-player unit, the damage boost effects are enhanced to #Y30%#E.

The duration of #YClear Law#E and #YNoble Path#E series effects is increased to #Y8#E seconds. When #YLethal#E is not active, dealing damage to an Exhausted Boss unit with <Golden Edict|781|#C|20204|20204101> or <Dragonheart Rush|781|#C|20205|20205105> fully restores #YSpear Momentum#E and applies Spring Might to the target. This effect triggers up to once every #Y60#E seconds.

#YLethal#E DMG Boost effect enhanced: <Hush & Calm Series Skills|781|#C|20204|20204201> now deal #Y10%#E increased base damage against player units and #Y30%#E against non-player units. In non-Arena modes, <Hush & Calm Series Skills|781|#C|20204|20204201> now cost #Y1#E #YSpear Momentum#E. While #YLethal#E is active, these skills and their triggered effects also gain additional Affinity DMG Boost and HP Drain effects.
